text: The Tour du Rwanda's own site lists under 'Institution Partners' the European Commission Global Gateway (commission.europa.eu), Rwanda's Ministry of Sports (minisports.gov.rw) and the Rwanda National Police (police.gov.rw); its partner tiers are Platinum Visit Rwanda, Golden Amstel, Silver BPR, MTN MoMo, BRD and Prime, and Bronze RwandAir and Ingufu Gin, with classification jerseys named after Amstel, BPR Bank, BRD, Sensitive Group, RwandAir, Ingufu Gin, MTN MoMo and Inyange.
short: Tour du Rwanda institution partners: EU Global Gateway, Ministry of Sports, Police
